dedupe_keys.name: regions hit tropical cyclone 11 event data sets igad climate prediction and applications center on hdx

description: Regions hit Tropical Cyclone (11 event data sets, IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center, on HDX) is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). 1984 Tropical Cyclone 04B was a weak storm that struck eastern Somalia in Mudug province, and quickly dissipated. The storm had a maximunm windspeed of 18m/s before dessipating. The cyclone was detected on 23/11/1984. Mudug landfall was on 7/12/1984. There were no reports of damages or injuries from this storm. Coverage: Somalia. The portal lists 11 near-identical data sets in this series (one per event, year, area or country), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher IGAD Climate Prediction and Applications Center (ICPAC). Its tags are geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 4 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, SHP, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-09-17 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
